score.description: How completely the issue describes the work, from 1 for a bare title to 10 for a description someone else could pick up without asking anything

verdict.description: The score in one word: ready to be worked on, workable but thin, or not actionable as written

missing.description: The pieces a reader needs and the description does not carry, each in two or three words

recommendation.description: The single most useful thing to add to the description, addressed to whoever wrote it
